text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day when I visited the infirmary, 
Sakura Laurel was tending to several 
students who looked in pain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Actually, some of the girls 
are suffering from dehydration.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
With the target race coming up so soon, it 
looks like she pushed herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, don't you worry! The nurse asked 
us to come take care of things!"

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! I feel so dizzy... Hey, am I gonna 
be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry. I'll hold your hand 
tight, tight, tight until you feel better♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please drink this oral rehydration 
solution for fluids. Can you drink it? 
I'll support you, come on—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just like our seniors before us, 
safeguarding the students' health is our 
duty as members of the Health Committee.

……I-I'm fine now! I'll overcome something 
like this, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: S-See! It's totally... no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... A hero never gives in to adversity, 
no matter what... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please excuse me for a moment! It 
looks like the health committee is needed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, are you worried about 
Laurel-chan? Don't you worry, that girl 
will be just fine~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, are you okay? Are you sure you 
should be moving around so much already?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! Because Carrotman would... even 
at a time like this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yeah, you certainly won't give 
up. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brushing back her bangs, she pressed her 
forehead against Biko Pegasus's as if 
checking for a fever—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it's still hot after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hu... Whoa, whoaaa...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're too close, Laurel-senpai...! I'm 
already totally fine, so—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, it feels cold...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's a present from me. Feels nice and 
cool, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Your dream of becoming a hero is 
wonderful. I think it's very cool! But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Not giving up and pushing yourself past 
your limits might seem similar, but 
they're completely... different.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Enduring the present brings you closer to 
your dream. I believe resting is necessary 
when you keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I understand how frustrating it is, 
Biko-chan. And that's precisely why――"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To become who you want to be— let's stand 
back up in top condition!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I want to try once more, in perfect 
condition...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Yeah, you're right. Resting 
isn't giving up.”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Laurel-senpai! I'm gonna get 
better and aim to be a hero again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Laurel-san. Even your mental 
care is flawless, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, no, compared to my seniors, I still 
have a long way to go! I need to try even 
harder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm honored to hear you say that. In 
order to protect the health of everyone at 
Tracen Academy—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Pure, kind, and strong. Always staying 
close by your side—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If someone's crying out in pain, I'll come 
running— Because that's what a health 
committee member does!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to get back on your feet as 
soon as possible. You can only give it 
your all after your body has healed."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I think staying healthy forever 
is truly the most important thing of all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"So of course I'll nurse them, but I 
really just want everyone to stay healthy, 
you know?♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Those kind words got me completely 
fired up, too!"
